title: HAdoc points
description: Physical things you can touch: switches, sensors, lights, sockets, flush boxes, hidden devices.

name.description: Plain-language name, e.g. 'Motion sensor above the mirror'.

pos.description: Position on the floor plan in cm; null while unknown.

height.description: Mounting height above the floor in cm.

if_broken.description: What to do when it stops working, in plain words.

device.description: Device ID when this point is (or hides) a device, e.g. a hidden ESP.
